title: Bifurcations from Weight Space: JEPAWG on Parametric Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.30847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trained network weights are increasingly treated as data, but there is rarely ground truth about what a population of models should encode, which hampers systematic validation of weight-space methods. This makes parametric dynamical systems a natural test-bed: the dynamics change qualitatively at submanifolds of parameter space that are, in well-studied families, known analytically or numerically. Fine-tuning a forecasting network at each point of a parameter grid yields a model zoo indexed by a physical parameter, against which weight-space diagnostics can be checked.   We build such model zoos for four dynamical systems and analyse them with JEPAWG, a recently proposed joint-embedding hypernetwork built around a learned parameter--weight representation. It was first introduced for neural samplers for lattice field theories, where its latent geometry located the phase transition and estimated the 2D Ising critical exponent. Applied to d

translated_title: 源自权重空间的分岔：JEPAWG 在参数化动力系统上的应用
translated_abstract: 训练后的网络权重日益被视为数据，但关于一群模型应当编码什么内容，鲜有真值（ground truth）可供参照，这阻碍了权重空间方法的系统性验证。这使参数化动力系统成为一个天然的试验平台：在研究充分的动力系统族中，动力学会在参数空间的某些子流形处发生质变，而这些子流形可以通过解析或数值方法获知。在参数网格的每个点上微调一个预测网络，便得到一个以物理参数为索引的模型动物园（model zoo），权重空间诊断方法可据此加以检验。我们为四个动力系统构建了这样的模型动物园，并用 JEPAWG——一种近期提出的、围绕学习到的参数-权重表示构建的联合嵌入超网络——对其进行分析。该方法最初是为格点场论的神经采样器而提出的，其潜在几何结构成功定位了相变并估计了二维 Ising 临界指数。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文以分岔结构已知的参数化动力系统为真值基准，构建以物理参数索引的模型动物园，验证了 JEPAWG 超网络能够从训练权重的潜在几何中定位动力学发生质变的分岔位置。
en_tdlr: The paper builds parameter-indexed model zoos from dynamical systems with analytically known bifurcation manifolds, validating that JEPAWG's joint-embedding hypernetwork can locate qualitative dynamics changes (bifurcations) from the latent geometry of trained weights.
